newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mixed, registrations trim nearbys.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mixed, registrations trim nearbys.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mixed with nearby months lower on a hike by roughly 500,000 cwt in the amount of rice registered for potential delivery.
"Another 500 receipts were registered and that pressured the market although they haven't come out (haven't been delivered," a trader said.
Trading was volatile, with an early break in the market finding good commercial buying.
"There was commercial buying on the early break and commercial buying late," the trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 800 contracts by the CBOT, above the 727 contracts traded Wednesday.
Rice closed 1-1/2 cent lower to four cents higher, with January unchanged at $11.14 per cwt.
